comparison.objective: Pull a cable from a feed channel to a 30 cm length mark and release it straight; candidate sets and locks a gripper opening angle.
comparison.physical_skill: Requires cable extraction, handover, visual length regulation, and flexible-object control, rather than driver/wrench countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Checks final length tolerance, straightness, retained feed length, overshoot, release, and fixture integrity; candidate checks angular accuracy, nuts, repeated actuation, drift, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Both regulate a target value, but cable-length positioning without locking or functional cycling tests a different physical ability.
